title: Frog reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- frog body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='26' ry='18' fill='#3fbf5a'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='16' ry='10' fill='#a8e6a0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#4fd06b'/>
  <!-- eye bumps -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='34' r='9' fill='#4fd06b'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='34' r='9' fill='#4fd06b'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='34' r='6' fill='#f4f4f4'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='34' r='6' fill='#f4f4f4'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='34' r='3' fill='#1a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='34' r='3' fill='#1a1a3a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M40 54 Q50 62 60 54' stroke='#2e8f42' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='52' r='4' fill='#ff9fb0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='52' r='4' fill='#ff9fb0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- arms holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='70' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#45c95f' transform='rotate(-25 30 70)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='70' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#45c95f' transform='rotate(25 70 70)'/>
  <!-- book -->
  <rect x='30' y='62' width='40' height='26' rx='2' fill='#e8503a'/>
  <rect x='30' y='62' width='40' height='4' fill='#c73d2a'/>
  <!-- book pages -->
  <rect x='33' y='68' width='17' height='18' fill='#fff6e0'/>
  <rect x='50' y='68' width='17' height='18' fill='#fef0cc'/>
  <!-- page lines -->
  <line x1='36' y1='73' x2='47' y2='73' stroke='#b9a98a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='36' y1='77' x2='47' y2='77' stroke='#b9a98a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='36' y1='81' x2='47' y2='81' stroke='#b9a98a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='73' x2='64' y2='73' stroke='#b9a98a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='77' x2='64' y2='77' stroke='#b9a98a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='81' x2='64' y2='81' stroke='#b9a98a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- book spine -->
  <line x1='50' y1='62' x2='50' y2='88' stroke='#c73d2a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='90' rx='9' ry='4' fill='#3fbf5a'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='90' rx='9' ry='4' fill='#3fbf5a'/>
</svg>
